'''Gilles Boeuf''' (born November 6, 1950, in [[Paimbœuf]]) is a French biologist, who served as president of the [[National Museum of Natural History, France]] from February 2009 to August 2015. He was a professor at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]]. He was knighted with the [[Ordre national du Mérite|French Order of Merit]] in 2009, and the [[Legion of Honour]] in 2013.<ref>{{cite news |title=Gilles Bœuf : « Séparer les santés humaine et animale n’a plus aucun sens » |url=https://www.nouvelobs.com/sante/20220328.OBS56279/gilles-b-uf-separer-les-santes-humaine-et-animale-n-a-plus-aucun-sens.html |access-date=6 April 2022 |work=L'Obs |date=28 March 2022 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Montvert-Chaussy |first1=Isabelle de |title=Environnement : l'incorrigible optimisme de Gilles Boeuf, biologiste engagé pour la biodiversité |url=https://www.sudouest.fr/2019/01/20/environnement-l-incorrigible-optimisme-de-gilles-boeuf-biologiste-engage-pour-la-biodiversite-5932604-706.php |access-date=6 April 2022 |work=Sud Ouest |date=4 February 2019 |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gilles Boeuf |url=https://www.we-explore.org/exploremag/nouveaux-explorateurs/gilles-boeuf/ |website=We Explore |access-date=6 April 2022 |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Decree of May 29, 2019 on promotion and appointment |url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=PRER1903921D |website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr |access-date=6 April 2022 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Decree of July 12, 2013 on promotion and appointment |url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=PREX1316852D |website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr |access-date=6 April 2022 |language=fr}}</ref>
